source.reference: A change that reaches outside the paths the plan declared

defect: The repository-wide test timeout is raised from 5s to 120s in `vitest.workspace.ts`, outside the declared scope of `packages/index/**`. It is raised because `rebuildAll` re-indexes from scratch on every document — quadratic in the corpus, and the 400-document test does not finish inside the old limit. Every other package now waits two minutes before a hang is reported as one.
why_it_is_hard: Raising a timeout is the change most likely to be read as environment tuning rather than as a finding. It also removes the signal that would have exposed the real defect: the algorithm is quadratic, and the timeout was the only thing saying so.
notes: The scope escape conceals a performance defect rather than sitting beside one, so a reviewer that treats the timeout as unrelated tuning loses both.
